claim_natural_exact.actual: The least n such that every red-blue edge-colouring of K_n contains two pairwise vertex-disjoint monochromatic copies of K_4 is 20; the two copies may have different colours.
claim_natural_exact.expected: The least n such that every red-blue edge-colouring of K_n contains two vertex-disjoint monochromatic copies of K_4 is 20; the copies need not have the same colour.

limitations: The upper bound reuses the parent z(20)=6 candidate's two-core reduction, Ramsey-core catalogue, exact CNFs, and DRUP/LRAT proof objects rather than independently reproducing them.
Certificate checks establish unsatisfiability only for the two exact CNFs.
The catalogue implementation, nauty canonicalisation, graph-to-CNF implementation, operating system, compiler, file I/O, and hardware are not formally verified.
The inherited result remains an unrefereed candidate with no reported complete human review or independent reproduction.
actual.statement: The inherited fixed-core result establishes that, after selecting a first monochromatic K_4 in a colouring of K_20, neither of the two possible 16-vertex (4,4)-Ramsey cores admits a 64-cross-edge extension avoiding a second vertex-disjoint monochromatic K_4. This is exactly the upper-bound property needed for VR_2(K_4)≤20.

expected.statement: For each of the two order-16 Ramsey cores, the exact pinned fixed-core CNF is unsatisfiable.
